title: Copilot · 实施详情
intro: 本页是 Copilot tab 前端的现状/差距/实施计划/测试,1:1 对应设计页 copilot_design(原子 #54–#65)。设计已说清『应该怎样』,这里写『现在怎样、差多少、按什么顺序补、怎么测』。代码一律按『文件名 + 函数/对象名』引用(可全局搜索定位,不写行号——行号会漂、名字稳定);copilot 前端文件在 apps/studio/frontend/src/components/studio/settings/copilot/ 下(CopilotTab.tsx / copilot-role-derivation.ts / copilot-role-test.ts / CopilotModelGroupCard.tsx),后端 copilot SDK 驱动在 apps/studio/backend/app/services/copilot.py(即 gateway 后端的 sidecar 侧),SDK 测试 job 编排在 routers/llm.py。底层依赖的 route 解析/SDK 测试机制见 copilot_mech_route。重要现状定性:spec §7.4 把这页定性为『桩/mock/假测试最多』,但 §7.4 是较早的审计快照;以现码为准,§7.4 列的多数桩/mock/假测试/分流 bug 在现码已修(去 mock、真 SDK 测试、role_kind 分流、统一保存状态徽章 SaveStatusBadge)。**2026-06-20 更新**:四项残留偏差（动态浮出未挂载、模型配置入口缺、model-group Remove 占位、Built-in 元数据启发式）随 copilot-settings-mvp1-conformance Wave A+B 已全部落地,#54-#65 全部 fe_status=符合;Wave C 系列收尾项（共享状态灯 / WS reconnect / i18n toast / a11y / 键盘传感器 / quit flush / cooling / shell-role）追加在 §7.5 续做,均不属于 #54-#65 原子范畴。**2026-07-01 更新**:Copilot 页面壳层对齐 LLM Roles,新增右侧 Available Models 模型库;Add model 创建空 Copilot 角色后,用户可把右侧模型卡拖入空/已配置的 Copilot 角色卡来设置或替换唯一 model group。

functions.current: Current: implemented and aligned. EmptyCopilotRoleCard(CopilotTab.tsx) matches LLM Roles: the outer shell is a normal role card and the body is a dashed `Drop model` target. It is not a form/select card and no longer renders any model group select or combobox. The drag gesture is owned by the shared useAvailableModelPointerDrag hook(available-model-pointer-drag.tsx) used by both LLM Roles and Copilot. The Copilot-specific drop path is AvailableModelsSidebar -> handleAvailableModelPointerDown -> pointerup over data-model-drop-zone -> copilotRoleIdFromModelDropTarget walking up to data-role-name -> dropCopilotModelOnRole -> applyCopilotModelGroupSelection(copilot-role-derivation.ts). The write keeps roleId as the key and updates active_model, models[modelGroupId].providers, and fallback_chain. Dropping onto a configured role replaces its single model group and rebuilds the route chain. The entry uses the full backend Model Groups list, supports non-Claude groups such as Doubao/GPT/DeepSeek, preserves role key and role_kind, and keeps the role under Copilot rather than graph-agent.
